method.description: Individually inspected chronological overview sheet of 12 evenly spaced frames plus denser sheets sampling every fourth frame and final frame. Compared against previously visually inspected exact-hash source. Metadata verified with ffprobe. No realtime playback claimed.

observations: Green snail, yellow/purple spiral shell, red mushroom with turquoise spots and blue ground retain their main colors and recognizable forms.
Small eye-stalk/head and body changes occur, but most visible displacement is the entire snail, mushroom and blue ground drifting together to the right.
Right mushroom-cap edge loses its safe margin and is clipped by the frame in late samples, including the final frame.
defects: Blocking framing defect: composition drifts right and clips the mushroom cap near the end.
limitations: Sampling cannot guarantee frame-perfect smoothness, absence of every inter-sample artifact or seamless looping.
scope: Exact-MP4 sampled visual reward-video gate only. Does not approve processed painting assets or integration.
suggestions: Lock mushroom and ground position, keep camera fixed and preserve clear margins on every side. Animate small snail eye-stalk/head/body movements or a tiny bounded glide without moving the entire scene off-screen.
approval_basis: Explicit user selection of original attempt 1 on 2026-10-04
user_statement: btw I don't know what happened to video reward on 32 but the attempt 1 looked fine we can use that
